description: One quarterly cycle at Meridian, recorded. Ten requests go out and nine inbound messages come back: four decisions, and five that are not (an ambiguous reply, a prose reply, an out of office, a colleague answering for an owner on leave, and a bounce from the mail system). One record is amended two days after its owner confirmed it, and one request is never answered at all. `{digest}` is substituted with the record version actually sent to that owner.
